title: OTA unit pin file
description: ota-deployments repo: <appVersion>/<unit>.json pins the source of one unit for one release line to a release branch and a commit. TypeScript type `Pin`, helpers branchFor/validatePin/parsePinPath in packages/ota-core/src/pin.ts. NOT expressible: `branch` must equal `ota/<unit>/<appVersion>` for the unit and version taken from the file path (validatePin checks it).

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema; ignored by tools.

sha.description: Full 40-character lowercase hex commit id the unit is built from.
